title: VNFC controller-headroom second recast
context: The valid K1024 result was MB1024-D, while its earlier sparse-manifest failure remains technical only. Persistent Convergence selected a same-host, same-information causal one-deviation A/RECON successor. This is the direction's second recast, so current authority executes it but lowers sequencing priority among ACTIVE directions; only the owner may later PARK.

options.label: Continue R03 at lowest ACTIVE sequencing priority
options.consequence: R03 continues through CM/calibration/one remote result if admitted; lifecycle remains ACTIVE.

options.label: PARK the direction
options.consequence: Root records PARK; R03 stops at the next clean boundary and evidence remains immutable.

dm_reason: A concrete reversible A/RECON discriminator exists, so the second-recast rule continues it at lowest sequencing priority.

packet.question: VNFC 已发生第二次 direction recast，所有者是否让它按规则以 ACTIVE 最低排程优先级继续，还是改为 PARK？

changes_if_approved.to: ACTIVE 方向中的最低排程优先级；不改变 lifecycle

packet.if_refused: 若所有者选择 PARK，由 Root 形成 Portfolio 记录；当前科学结果、R03 卡片和所有历史 provenance 不重写。

evidence_for.why: 完整的 persistent Convergence node 明确形成第二次 recast 决定并给出可执行最小对象。

evidence_against.quote: It adds no lower-bound headroom. The sole material world remains zone 2 row 3.
evidence_against.why: K1024 的新增科学信息有限，继续投资的机会成本应受最低排程约束。

uncertainty: R03 可能因 wall cap 或 causal-key feasibility 形成技术 blocker。
R03 即使为 CI-A 也只支持 in-panel one-deviation 结论。

cost.compute: 先一次低于 60 秒 calibration，最多再一次 2700 秒 remote result invocation。
cost.owner_time: 异步二选一，无需阻塞研究循环。
cost.waits_on_this: 研究不等待 owner；owner 的 PARK 指令在下一 clean boundary 应用。
